verses.text: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.

verses.text: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.

verses.text: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.

verses.text: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
